title: MV Requesting TDDP_MouseSystemEx animated mouse cursor addition

posts.author: Syniy
posts.body:
Hello. Since it seems like the original author of TDDP_MouseSystemEx isn't around to work on the plugin anymore, I would like to place a request to make an addition to this plugin that would implement support for animated mouse cursors (something the author wanted to do but never got around making) that would be able to interact with the plugin the same way the non-animated do if possible.
I'm aware that there are two other mouse-related plugins that can do this sort of thing, but:
1. I unfortunately do not possess the means to access the paid versions of them that have this feature, and I couldn't find any free alternatives;
2. Even being old and unsupported, I haven't experienced any issues with TDDP_MouseSystemEx on my latest RPG Maker MV. I don't even use any fixes for it.
I'm aware that it's a big thing to ask, but I thought that I might as well try asking rather than do nothing. I will understand if it's impossible / too much to ask.
I'm using TDDP_MouseSystemEx 1.8.2.1, which can be downloaded from the author's post:
Mouse System Ex
Introduction  TDDP – MouseSystemEx lets you set and change custom mouse cursors during gameplay and event interaction; enables mouse interaction to trigger events without the player character; show icons next to the mouse, and much more.  Before asking for help, please read the documentation...
